artwork.information:
A Plate of Oysters

Price: AUD 200.00

In stock

Stefan Farina ‘A Plate of Oysters’ 58x76cmsynthetic polymer on canvas This painting has been created for the exhibition, REFLECTIONS: Observations of the Everyday. REFLECTIONS invites QArt’s talented artists to tell the stories of their daily life with unique, autobiographical perspectives, and present new worlds through the lens of creatives with disability. By exploring found and curated objects tied to memory, lived experience and identity, the artists gently draw attention to their access needs by referencing their accommodation and studio space. Forming culture and community in a collaborative, supported work environment guided by highly skilled and experienced mentors, and finding comfort and freedom in making art. As the artists narrate their first-person human experience, they shift the paradigm of living with disability away from a focus on deficit or lack, and toward creativity, skill, innovation, problem solving and celebrating difference.

Frolicking with the Whales (2023) By Henry DeakinAcrylic on canvas72 cm H x 56 cm W Complete your interior space with an original painting from QArt Gallery. Purchasing artwork from QArt Gallery allows us to keep our artists in secure employment and enables them to live productive and engaged lives in the community. All of our artists are available for commissions. So, if you enjoy the aesthetic of a particular painting but would prefer to make some minor tweaks to its size or palette so that it may be absolutely perfect for your space, that’s fine! Or, if you wish to bring your own idea to life, we can assist with that, too. We’ll work with you to create a bespoke and unique work of art to your specifications and keep you updated with progress images along the way. For more information about commissions, please get in touch with us through the Contact page.
